name: insider-cinematic-studio
description: Nine skills that make an agent work like a motion design, editing and VFX studio: concept, storyboard and art direction; extruded 3D typography living in the same space as objects; camera moves with real lenses, depth of field and graph-editor curves; bloom, light trails, particles, glass, chrome and HUD; compositing real footage with mattes, tracking and speed ramps; photoreal products and logos in Blender; beat-synced editing with synthesized sound design; real motion blur, LUTs, halation and delivery; and QC that flags the AI-video look. Ships a Remotion + three.js project with five looks and five example films.
